name: Kétújfalu (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kétújfalu (a green shield with a white and yellow wing and a sword) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed KÉTÚJFALU.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kétújfalu arms with wreath and scroll
